description: This file defines ASN.1 E1AP protocol message structures, including message types, procedures, and containers for 3GPP E1 Application Protocol (E1AP) messages, with classes for different message types and procedures.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the initial E1AP message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful response message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents an unsuccessful response message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: e1ap_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the top-level E1AP Protocol Data Unit (PDU) which can be one of init, success, or failure message types.

classes.name: e1ap_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Contains definitions for different E1AP elementary procedures, including request, response, and failure types.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the message to JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj
methods.description: Loads message info based on procedure code.
